lines.en: I knock on Molly’s door and wait to see if she’s around.
I can hear the sound effects from some game or anime going off in the background, so I imagine she is.
Tsuneyo doesn’t seem like she would be the type to spend her free time on that, so process of elimination really only leaves the one I came here to see in the first place.
: Who goes there?!
: Your teacher.
: Oh, Master!
: You may enter!
I grab the handle and attempt to open the door, but it appears to be locked.
: I can’t enter if the door is locked, Molly.
: Oh. Uhhh, crap. Give me a second.
: I’m in the middle of a thing in a game.
: Can’t you just pause it?
: Pause it? What year is this, 2005?
: Have I activated my time-jump ability on accident?!
: Just...hurry up and finish your game. It always feels strange standing in the middle of the hallway here.
: Roger! Just gotta pop my CD’s and...
: Done!
I hear a set of frantic footsteps clopping against the floor as Molly rushes to the door and pulls it open.
: What ever happened to the good old days where you were able to pause video games?
: Those days have long since vanished, Sir. Lost like teardrops in the rain.
: Insightful. Is that a line out of a dating game?
: Probably, Sir. Though I don’t know which one off the top of my head.
Molly begins to play with one of the sleeves of her hoodie, incessantly plucking at the same spot over and over again.
She looks surprisingly cute in her...rather Irish-themed pajamas.
I can’t help but notice a rather fresh aroma permeating throughout the room as well.
: What is that smell?
: Me, Sir. Lemon scented shampoo.
: I just took a bath with Ami and Maya.
: We were discussing the logistics of our upcoming campaign at the edge of the world.
: You mean the beach?
: I do, Sir. The beach is what it appears as to those not blessed with clairvoyance.
: But people like you and I see it for what it truly is.
: I see it as a beach.
: You will know the meaning in time, Sir. A beach is not simply a beach when it is filled with blossoming [young]ladies like myself, Sir.
: A true haven for degeneracy. A real set-up for top-notch H-scenes and lost bikini tops.
: I think you watch too much anime.
: Though, I guess none of that sounds bad to me.
: There is no such thing as too much anime. Especially when there are so many cute figures to collect.
: You’re still planning on getting more? You have plenty.
: Always, Sir. I will spend every penny I earn from the cafe and the pictures you purchase from me on objects to fuel my passion.
: Speaking of which, do you happen to have any of those pictures yet?
: Plenty of time has passed by, so if you don't have any, you owe me a good excuse.
: I regret to inform you that I do not have any. Please accept the following excuse.
: The stuff I ordered online just came in the other day and none of it really fits. I’m growing at an alarming rate.
: I’m having a hard time believing that. You’re one of the smallest girls in the class.
: Day by day, I stray further and further from the loli tag.
: Who will ever love me if I become an average-sized girl?
: I mean, I think you’d be cute either way.
: Thank you, Sir. I would return the compliment if you had one less dimension.
: You’re sure blushing a lot for someone who isn’t interested in 3D characters.
: Hormones, Sir.
: They control the brains of [young]women like myself and make us act in ways we normally regret.
: Is that Mollyspeak for saying you’re getting turned on?
: O-Of course not! What would the players think if an innocent virgin like me received her first H-scene in her initial update?!
: I’m sure there would be plenty of players who’d be absolutely thrilled by that.
: Guh...I’m not ready to grow up yet...
: I haven’t even unlocked the fabled “first kiss” CG.
: Kissing is overrated anyway. Once you get older, you’ll realize that relationships become more about sex than actual affection.
: Well, in my experience at least.
: Sir, this may be hard for you to hear, but I’m beginning to feel a bit uncomfortable with the direction this conversation is headed.
: It’s one thing to talk about sex in games, but the real life kind sounds...scary.
: Though...I suppose if you were to use a command seal...
: I would be forced to oblige...
Molly is clearly starting to get a little flustered, so I might as well take things down a notch before I actually do something to hurt her.
Despite being a full on, admissible pervert when it comes to video games, she still clearly isn’t ready for the actual thing yet.
But I guess that’s not too hard to understand given the type of person she is.
It seems that Molly is willing to do virtually anything in order to separate herself from the real world.
And if deflowering every character in every game she plays is how she wants to do that, more power to her.
: Oh! Sir!
: Wow. You got over that whole 'hormonal embarrassment' thing pretty quickly.
: ADHD, Sir. There's not a lot of space on my hard drive so I need to constantly delete things to make place for new ones.
: Gotcha. So what is it that captured your mind this time around?
Molly moves several steps closer to her computer and starts to look at something in the corner of the room.
I stare at the same corner as well and see nothing, so I’m not quite sure what it is she’s looking at.
: I actually have something I’d like to confide in you about.
: Oh? What’s with the sudden shift in tone?
: I will explain the step-by-step process as to how I wound up here.
: It all began with the mention of sex.
: Which then made me think about nudity.
: Which then made me think about my own personal experiences with nudity.
: Which then reminded me of something I saw recently.
: Which then somehow distracted me from thinking about the thing that made me think about all of those things in the first place.
: I’m...not sure if I follow.
: Then I will get right to the point.
: What is the right thing to do when you find out that someone you care about is hurting themself?
: I think I saw something I wasn’t supposed to see.
: I don’t know what to do.
: Is it okay if I ask for a few more details?
I’m almost positive I know what this is about, but I don’t want to reveal anything until I’m sure.
: Well...Let’s just say that girls sometimes use the same dressing room as one another when they go shopping.
: And a girl I happened to be changing with had some marks on her that I’m smart enough to recognize.
: I might be a huge geek, but I know when to snap out of it.
: I obviously didn’t say anything because like, what do you even say when you see something like that?
: “Are you okay? What happened? Do you need help?”
: Those are all things that would make her catch on.
: And now I’m in this weird place where there are a million things I wanna say but none of them will come out because I’m afraid of people getting mad at me.
: This person sounds really important to you.
: Yeah.
: They are.
: Very important.
: Like, so important that I just wanna squeeze her and be like “Wake up!” and not let go until she promises to not do anything like that again.
: My mom killed herself when I was little. So ever since then I’ve tried to be really conscious about how other people feel.
: But even when you know they’re not feeling well, it’s not like you can actually do anything about it.
: You can’t even make jokes because then it will seem like you’re just brushing everything off.
: So I wanna know what you would do in my position.
: Hahah...Hahahah! Pretty crazy how we wound up here all of a sudden, right?
: The dorms must be possessed by some kind of dark entity or something! Right?
: That’s gotta be it!
: That’s gotta be it...
: And it’s gotten to her too. And it’s making her do weird things to her arms.
: So all we need to do is take down whatever entity is spreading all of these negative emotions around and everything will go back to normal.
: Everything will go back to normal.
: It’s all just part of an evil conspiracy.
Molly picks at the fabric of her clothes even harder than before.
Her hands are shaking as tears begin to slowly but surely stream down her pale, white cheeks and drip onto the sleeves of her hoodie.
Meanwhile, I sit across from her...At a table the same girl she’s so concerned about often shows up to in order to play games and get away from everything.
We’re all looking to get away from everything. And we all have different ways to do that.
But what happens when someone you know forgets how?
What do you do?
I doubt Molly wanted to talk about this at all.
It just managed to grab hold of her and force her head underwater before she could do anything about it.
And so everything just started to leak out.
Everything always leaks out.
: This sounds like a job for your master.
: Come on...Don’t drop the act now.
: I finally start playing along and you’re going to give me that face?
: If you care so much about this person and you want to get rid of the “demon” or whatever it was you said was possessing them, we just have to defeat it. Right?
: Maybe it’s time I show off my true power?
: I’m the Supreme whatever it is-
: Supreme Overlord. Herald of the Adolescents.
: Yeah. That thing.
: And besides, I’m pretty sure I know who you’re talking about anyway.
: You do?
: Yeah. It’s something I’ve known about for a while. And I care about her just as much as you do.
: Oh yeah?
: You dare challenge the love of the Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest?
: You may be my master, but you must know by now that there are aspects of power where even I surpass you.
Her eyes return to the same corner she’s continuously focused on throughout this impromptu confession.
I guess it’s a habit of hers. Just like plucking at the strings of fabric on her clothing.
It’s great being able to find things that will calm you down while your mind runs wild.
You need to stay grounded or you’ll eventually just float off into the ether.
There’s your half-assed philosophy for the day, coming from a man who seems to always just-so-happen to be around girls when they start to cry.
Sometimes, I wonder if they’d cry at all if I were to just leave.
: There’s no need to challenge anyone here. It’s clear how worried you are by how you’re acting right now.
: That’s because of the dark entity.
: Right. The dark entity.
: So if the dark entity happens to wipe our memories of this conversation, everything will be just like it was before, right?
: It can do that?!
: It’s even more powerful than I thought!
: Are you sure you’ll be able to handle it, Master?
: I may be small, but I’m willing to assist you in any possible way. Just name it!
It’s hard for me to tell if Molly is just acting right now or if all of these words are her true feelings wrapped in intentionally faked delusions of grandeur.
Maybe she does think that there is something she can do to help bring Rin back to normal.
But before any of that, I need to find out if something’s actually going on again or if the marks she saw were the same ones I did.
: You can assist me by guarding yourself, Molly. You’re of no use to me if you fall victim to the darkness as well.
: Ahh, an excellent plan, Sir. I will support you from the backlines, just as any good priest would.
: I’ll be sure to cast Power Word: Shield on you before you pull.
: I...wouldn’t have it any other way.
We find a way to carry on our conversation without ever directly addressing anything again.
Life is easier that way.
Sometimes, you need to disguise your problems as happier things to avoid the dark entity consuming you.
And even if Molly is too much to handle at most hours of the day, I do want to protect her.
Just as I want to protect the rest of the girls.
She doesn’t deserve to be beaten down the way so many others have been.
So if there’s anything I can do about that-
I will gladly do it.
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
